scheme_name: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana
other_conditions: Students must have passed 10th and 12th standard (or be studying in class XII) from schools in Delhi.
Applicants must have secured a prescribed percentage of marks in the qualifying examinations for which coaching is provided.
Income and Caste certificates issued by the concerned District Magistrate must be submitted.
Beneficiaries must attend all classes; attendance loss of more than 15 days without valid reason leads to discontinuation of benefits.
Selection of students is done by the coaching institution based on academic criteria or merit.
A student can avail the scheme benefits for a maximum of two times across competitive examinations.
benefits_summary: Eligible SC students receive up to 75% of the coaching fee (maximum ₹40,000 per candidate) and a monthly stipend of ₹2,500.
